_meta.directive: H-1 2026-08-14: Meshy + Tripo, richer assets, cuter cats, rich beautiful game
_meta.art_direction: product_spec.md section 7 — tabletop diorama: hand-built model railway of a cat city on a wooden desk, modular low-poly, toon shader family, warm lighting, charming not childish
_meta.colorblind_rule: line colors never appear alone — every line-affiliated cat carries color + symbol redundancy (circle red, square blue, triangle yellow, diamond green, star wild) plus a distinct silhouette per color; cat-conductor is the unaffiliated mascot (base cream/navy palette, no line color)
_meta.custody: outputs land in unity/Assets/Art/Generated/incoming/ (gitignored); candidates are local until curated + provenance'd; license/asset ADR owed before any of these ship in the Play binary
_meta.style_base: low-poly hand-painted toy figurine style for a wooden desktop model railway diorama, soft rounded shapes with no sharp exterior edges, warm cozy lighting, flat toon-friendly colors, clean silhouette readable at small size, charming not childish
